next_step: Finalize POC SLAs + security checklist sign-off
notes: PulseBridge is a mid-market contact center platform targeting omnichannel support. Primary ask: real-time agent assist (streaming token-level suggestions into agent UI), plus post-call ticket summarization and automated tool-calls into Zendesk/SFDC. POC started 2024-11-20, short scope: integrate streaming SDK into React agent desktop, validate latency SLOs and guardrails. Key quotes: 'If suggestion latency >100ms agents lose trust' and 'We need audit trail for every suggestion and tool action.' Security: must run via VPC private endpoints, SSO (SAML) mandatory, KMS-managed keys, 12+ months audit retention, and EU data residency for some enterprise customers. POC metrics so far: median RTT for suggestion ~85ms, p95 ~220ms during simulated spikes (2x baseline concurrent). Primary technical concerns: cold-starts under burst, maintaining token-level privacy redaction, safe-fallthrough when model uncertain (confidence threshold and human-in-the-loop). Business constraints: finance asks for mapped cost per assisted interaction; legal needs a data residency attestation. Competitive evaluation includes OpenAI and Anthropic for hosted latency and Cohere for embeddings. Next deliverables: SLA draft for POC (latency targets, error budget), security questionnaire answers, demo recording and short prompt-set evaluating hallucination rate. Contacts = Product lead (Rajiv Menon), CTO (Lena Ortiz).
